leads.detail: Neuralink received FDA approval for its first U.S. pivotal clinical trial of an implantable brain-computer interface targeting ALS patients.
leads.why_relevant: Directly advances invasive brain-computer interfaces and neural decoding for motor restoration, matching neuromodulation and biosignal processing interests.

leads.detail: Nurovo secured backing from Genesis to develop an EEG-based wearable device designed to measure pain.
leads.why_relevant: Combines EEG signal acquisition and real-time physiological decoding in a wearable form factor.

leads.detail: Hyperdimensional Brainpower demonstrated ZAPCAP, a consumer-grade non-invasive dry-EEG baseball cap capable of controlling device cursors without conductive gel.
leads.why_relevant: Focuses on non-invasive dry electrode biosignal acquisition and real-time machine learning intent classification for wearables.

leads.detail: Lampsy Health raised €1.1 million to commercialize an AI-powered bedside monitoring lamp for detecting nocturnal epileptic seizures.
leads.why_relevant: Applies machine learning to continuous, non-contact physiological sensing for neurological monitoring.

leads.detail: Altair Semiconductor closed a $100 million Series A round to mass-produce ultra-low-power cellular modems for AI wearables and smart glasses.
leads.why_relevant: Provides essential hardware connectivity and low-power infrastructure for real-time wearable AI biosensing.

leads.detail: SPCTR raised €2.8 million to advance real-time intraoperative optical tissue assessment during cancer surgery.
leads.why_relevant: Integrates biomedical optics and real-time signal processing to assist intraoperative decision-making in medtech.

leads.detail: Lumius raised $4.5 million to deploy high-resolution 3D ultrasound imaging systems into hospital workflows.
leads.why_relevant: Demonstrates growth in medical imaging technology and digital signal processing applications for medtech.

leads.detail: Vantedge Medical acquired medical device component manufacturer Hobson & Motzer to scale custom medtech manufacturing capacity.
leads.why_relevant: Reflects growth and manufacturing expansion in medical device design and hardware production.
